intro: About 88% of Gabon is covered by rainforest, one of the highest shares in the world.

chapters.title: National parks
text: Gabon has 13 national parks. At Loango, elephants and hippos walk on beaches and humpback whales swim offshore. Lopé protects forest and savanna mosaic.

chapters.title: Rivers
text: The Ogooué River crosses the country to the Atlantic.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Gabon's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
